data.what_it_does: Provides a set of highly customizable button widgets that mimic the island‑style UI seen in apps like Duolingo. Includes regular, outlined, animated, and segmented button variants with many styling options.
use_when: you need uniquely styled buttons beyond the standard Material widgets
you want animated press feedback or segmented button groups
you require easy customization of shape, colors, and size
avoid_when: you need full‑blown UI kits or complex theming systems
you require platform‑specific native button behavior
strengths: wide range of button types and animations
extensive styling properties (size, colors, border, shape)
weaknesses: focuses only on button widgets, no broader UI components
no built‑in state‑management or theming engine
limited to visual customization, no functional extensions
